alert.description: The identifier of the Alert resource that defines this alertAction.

headerName.description: The request header name for authentication to the endpoint.

headerValue.description: The request header value for authentication to the endpoint.

options.description: When the 'type' field of this resource is set to 'web', this field determines the format that the Alert data should be sent in.

value.description: A value used to deliver the alert. Thie field should be set to an email address if the type is email, an endpoint if the type is web, etc.

retries.description: The number of times an alert should be resent in case of a failure. This fields can only be set for web type alertActions.
